Content following a table whose last row is never closed is still converted

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<table><tr><th>Before</th></tr><tr></table><p>Visible footer</p>"
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
